# FlattenStrings: in a union with a plain string, the other string-like
# members (enums, transformed strings) merge into the string.
builder prov
str s unrestricted n=Str desc=plain
prim dt date-time n=When
prim uuid uuid
enum e a,b n=E
prim i integer
union u1 s,dt,e,i n=U1
union u2 s,uuid n=U2
union u3 dt,uuid,i n=NoString
cls top a:u1,b:u2,c:u3 n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
query named
flattenstrings debug
gc
print
flattenstrings

# Only restricted strings are an error.
builder
str s cases=a:1
prim dt date-time
union u s,dt n=U
cls top u:u n=Top
top Top top
finish
flattenstrings
